pluginDescription: Independently toggleable desktop and mobile enhancements for SiYuan; every setting item can be enabled, disabled or hidden on its own.
panel.none: No setting item is visible right now. Check feature-control.json at the repository root.
panel.readonlyTip: SiYuan is in read-only or publish mode, so settings cannot be saved.
dialog.discardText: You have unsaved changes. Closing now discards them.
feature.modalBlur.name: Blur behind modals
feature.modalBlur.desc: Applies a backdrop blur to the dialog scrim so the editor behind it is softened while the dialog itself stays sharp.
feature.docTreeOpenedAccent.name: Accent for the opened note
feature.docTreeOpenedAccent.desc: Draws an accent bar on the left edge of the currently opened note in the document tree; the colour is configurable.
feature.docTreeTitleMarkdown.name: Inline Markdown in document tree titles
feature.docTreeTitleMarkdown.desc: Renders bold, italic, bold italic, strikethrough, highlight, superscript, subscript and inline code in notebook and document titles of the document tree.
feature.headingLevelIcon.name: Heading level in the title icon
feature.headingLevelIcon.desc: Uses the H1-H6 icons for heading blocks in the reference list and the search panel, with the level drawn in the bottom right corner.
docTreeOpenedAccent.colorTip: Leave empty to follow the SiYuan theme primary; any CSS colour such as #rrggbb, rgb() or var(--b3-theme-primary) works
feature.mobileDockBlur.name: Blur behind the mobile dock bar
feature.mobileDockBlur.desc: Turns the floating mobile dock bar into frosted glass so the document blurs underneath while scrolling.
feature.mobileBarAnimation.name: Smoother mobile bars
feature.mobileBarAnimation.desc: Adds a smooth transition to the show/hide behaviour of the mobile top bar, breadcrumb and floating dock bar; the dock bar only switches between fully shown and fully hidden.
feature.mobileSyncButton.name: Always show Sync on mobile
feature.mobileSyncButton.desc: Keeps the Sync button visible in the mobile top-right corner.
feature.hideMobileExit.name: Hide the mobile Quit button
feature.hideMobileExit.desc: Hides the icon-only Quit button in the mobile side panel.
feature.hideAgentWelcomeExamples.name: Hide the agent's suggested prompts
feature.hideAgentWelcomeExamples.desc: Hides the example prompts on the agent panel's new-session screen, so an accidental click cannot start a conversation and spend tokens.
feature.agentEnterToSend.name: Send the agent message with Enter
feature.agentEnterToSend.desc: Sends the agent message with Enter; use Ctrl+Enter or Shift+Enter to insert a line break (Cmd+Enter on macOS).
feature.agentThinkingStickyHeader.name: Pin the agent thinking header
feature.agentThinkingStickyHeader.desc: Pins the "Thought for N s" header of an expanded thinking card to the top of the panel, so a long thought can be collapsed at any time.
feature.agentToolCallDetail.name: Details for the agent's tool calls
feature.agentToolCallDetail.desc: Tool calls in a thinking card are no longer just a name: each one is followed by the arguments it ran with, and hovering shows the full arguments and the result.
feature.codeBlockLangEmpty.name: Never remember the code language
feature.codeBlockLangEmpty.desc: New code blocks always start with an empty language instead of reusing the language picked last time.
feature.dailyNoteDirect.name: Create the daily note directly
feature.dailyNoteDirect.desc: Creates the daily note in the notebook chosen below instead of asking which notebook to use.
dailyNoteDirect.notebookTip: Only currently opened notebooks are listed; choosing None keeps SiYuan's own prompt
feature.firstDocIcon.name: Fixed first document icon
feature.firstDocIcon.desc: Uses the emoji below the first time a document gets an icon instead of a random one.
firstDocIcon.emojiTip: Enter a single emoji; leave empty to go back to a random icon
feature.externalLinkConfirm.name: Confirm before opening a web link
feature.externalLinkConfirm.desc: Asks before opening an http/https link and shows the full URL.
externalLinkConfirm.title: Open this external link?
externalLinkConfirm.prompt: The following link will be opened in your browser:
feature.kernelReconnectButton.name: Reconnect button on the disconnect panel (experimental)
feature.kernelReconnectButton.desc: Adds a Reconnect button to the kernel-disconnected panel: it probes whether the kernel is back and then reloads the frontend to reconnect — SiYuan gives plugins no way to reconnect the kernel directly, so the whole interface refreshes once.
kernelReconnectButton.label: Reconnect now
kernelReconnectButton.offline: The kernel is still unreachable; please try again in a moment.
feature.kernelAutoReconnect.name: Automatic reconnect after a disconnect (experimental)
feature.kernelAutoReconnect.desc: After the kernel connection drops, probes the kernel using the count and interval below and reloads the frontend to reconnect as soon as it answers: the whole interface refreshes once, exactly as with Reconnect now.
kernelAutoReconnect.attemptsTip: Set to 0 to disable automatic attempts
feature.mobileRefPanelHeight.name: Taller mobile candidate panel
feature.mobileRefPanelHeight.desc: Raises the height of the mobile candidate panel used for reference search and friends to a share of the viewport, without passing the bottom of the visible area.
mobileRefPanelHeight.maxHeightTip: Share of the viewport height; the real height is also capped by the space between the panel and the bottom of the screen
feature.mobileSelectNative.name: Native SiYuan style for mobile dropdowns
feature.mobileSelectNative.desc: Opening a dropdown on mobile shows SiYuan's own menu and still fires change on selection.
feature.mobileLongpressMenuLabel.name: Labels in the mobile long-press menu
feature.mobileLongpressMenuLabel.desc: Adds text to the icon-only buttons in the mobile long-press menu; the back button keeps its icon only.
feature.mobileBlockIconAlways.name: Keep the block icon visible on mobile
feature.mobileBlockIconAlways.desc: Keeps the block icon visible while a block is being operated on mobile; clicking it still opens the native menu.
feature.inlineCodeCopy.name: Copy button for inline code
feature.inlineCodeCopy.desc: Adds a copy button to inline code, shown on hover, always, or not at all.
inlineCodeCopy.label: Copy inline code
feature.commandPanelSlim.name: Slimmer desktop command panel
feature.commandPanelSlim.desc: Shrinks the desktop command panel to a share of SiYuan's native width.
commandPanelSlim.widthTip: Share of SiYuan's native width (80vw); 50% equals 40vw
feature.codeSnippetHighlight.name: Syntax highlighting for snippets
feature.codeSnippetHighlight.desc: Colours the snippet editor under Settings using CSS/JS syntax, following the selected code theme. It does not apply yet while the desktop app uses an independent settings window; please wait for a later update.
feature.devtoolsHotkey.name: F12 toggles the developer tools on desktop
feature.devtoolsHotkey.desc: Presses F12 on desktop to open or close the developer tools, the same entry as the one in the status bar context menu.
feature.mobileConsoleLog.name: Console log viewer
feature.mobileConsoleLog.desc: Collects console output from the moment the plugin loads and shows the full log in a dialog.
feature.deepseekBalance.name: DeepSeek balance in the agent panel
feature.deepseekBalance.desc: With the official api.deepseek.com DeepSeek model it reads the API key configured under Settings - AI, polls the balance on the interval below and shows it below the agent panel composer.
deepseekBalance.intervalTip: Time between two queries, 1 second minimum
deepseekBalance.label: DeepSeek balance:
deepseekBalance.noProvider: No enabled DeepSeek model on api.deepseek.com (enable one under Settings - AI)
deepseekBalance.failed: Could not fetch the DeepSeek balance
deepseekBalance.empty: The API returned no balance information
deepseekBalance.insufficient: Balance too low to keep calling the API
feature.ossUsage.name: Aliyun OSS bucket usage
feature.ossUsage.desc: Adds a usage button to SiYuan's S3 storage settings that queries the bucket's storage and object count with the credentials saved there; it stays hidden unless the endpoint is Aliyun OSS. The button does not appear yet while the desktop app uses an independent settings window; please wait for a later update.
ossUsage.title: Bucket usage
ossUsage.networkHint: The kernel sends this request for the plugin, but it never got out: check the network connection and the endpoint.
ossUsage.missingConfig: The S3 settings are incomplete; fill in and save these fields first: {fields}
mobileConsoleLog.capacityTip: The oldest entries are dropped once this is exceeded
mobileConsoleLog.openTip: Read every entry, copy the whole log, or clear it
mobileConsoleLog.title: Console log
feature.clearConfig.name: Clear this plugin's configuration
feature.clearConfig.desc: Deletes every configuration file in this plugin's storage directory, putting all features back into their just-installed state.
clearConfig.title: Clear all configuration
clearConfig.tip: Deletes every configuration file in this plugin's storage directory, including those left by features this client does not load or by retired features, and then reloads the frontend. This cannot be undone.
clearConfig.confirmText: This deletes every configuration file in this plugin's storage directory and then reloads the frontend. It cannot be undone.
feature.pluginReminder.name: About this plugin
feature.pluginReminder.desc: What this plugin is, its current version, and where to report problems.
pluginReminder.notice:
This plugin is built and maintained by an individual. It is not an official SiYuan feature and is not part of the SiYuan project itself.
Every feature is off by default and is enabled one by one; the plugin works by taking over SiYuan's own settings entry and parts of its interface behaviour, so individual features may break after a major SiYuan update, and plugins that touch the same part of the interface can interfere with each other.
Current version: v{version}. When something misbehaves, reload the plugin or turn the related feature off first; if the problem remains, please report it in the repository.
GitHub repository: {repo}
feature.panelNoAutofocus.name: Do not focus the first control when a settings panel opens
feature.panelNoAutofocus.desc: Keeps the focus off the first control when a settings panel opens, so the mobile keyboard stays down. While the desktop app uses an independent settings window, SiYuan's own settings window is not covered yet (this plugin's panel is unaffected); please wait for a later update.
feature.configTransfer.name: Import and export this plugin's configuration
feature.configTransfer.desc: Writes every configuration file in this plugin's storage directory into one JSON document, and reads such a document back.
configTransfer.exportTip: Opens every configuration file in this plugin's storage directory as one read-only JSON document, ready to copy.
configTransfer.copyFailed: Could not write to the clipboard; select the text and copy it manually
configTransfer.importTip: Paste a JSON document exported by this plugin; every entry is written back to its own configuration file, even for a feature this client does not load, and the frontend reloads afterwards.
configTransfer.invalidJson: That is not valid JSON; nothing was imported
configTransfer.invalidShape: That JSON is not a plugin configuration: it must map feature ids to configuration objects
configTransfer.imported: Imported {count} configuration file(s), ignored {skipped} unrecognised entry/entries
feature.refCrumbsGuide.name: Guide to the Ref Crumbs plugin
feature.refCrumbsGuide.desc: Points to another plugin by the same author, and opens its settings panel or its marketplace page from here.
refCrumbsGuide.notice:
Ref Crumbs is another plugin by the same author: it appends the heading chain (h2-h6) of every result in the block reference search list.
This row only points you there. It changes nothing in your notes, and whether to install it is up to you.
refCrumbsGuide.actionTip: Opens its settings panel when the plugin is enabled here, otherwise its page in the marketplace.
refCrumbsGuide.bazaarUnavailable: The marketplace is turned off on this device, so its page cannot be opened
feature.tabTitleMarkdown.name: Inline Markdown in tab titles
feature.tabTitleMarkdown.desc: Renders inline Markdown in tab titles: the desktop tab bar with its dropdown list, and the mobile tab overview.
feature.assetInfoMenu.name: File size and metadata in the asset menu
feature.assetInfoMenu.desc: Shows the file size, image dimensions, type and modified time of a workspace asset in the menu of images, audio, video and iframe blocks and of inline links pointing at an asset.
feature.bookmarkLastPosition.name: Jump to the last position when a bookmark opens a note
feature.bookmarkLastPosition.desc: Opens a whole-document bookmark through the same path as the document tree, restoring the last reading position; bookmarks on a block are left alone.
feature.recordingWindow.name: A floating window instead of the recording notice
feature.recordingWindow.desc: Replaces the notice SiYuan shows while recording with a floating window that shows the elapsed time and stops the recording from there.
feature.exitConfirm.name: Ask before quitting
feature.exitConfirm.desc: Asks before SiYuan quits: the Quit item in the main menu and closing the window when SiYuan is set to quit on close; quitting from the desktop tray menu does not ask.
exitConfirm.title: Quit SiYuan
